Name: Plurai Simulation
Tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
Description: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

Name: YouArt Desktop App
Tagline: Codex for creative team
Description: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

Name: Neura HQ
Tagline: The agentic conversational storefront for consumer brands
Description: In B2C, every touchpoint is a stay-or-leave decision. Customers find you through ads, social, or stores, and leave the moment they don’t get what they want. Neura is the agentic conversational storefront that meets them in that moment, wherever they are. It recommends, shares offers, checks online and in-store stock, points them to the nearest store, tracks orders and stays with them through the whole journey, like your best person on the floor. Set it up in minutes, just by talking to it.

Name: CanyonOS
Tagline: The One Platform for Scaling your Agentic Apps
Description: CanyonOS is a workflow-aware platform to build, scale, observe and manage agentic applications. It carries every call between your agents, so it can automatically find and scale just the ones holding up your workflow and show how much each agent adds to your costs, with no tracing code to write. Your agents stay plain Python. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

Name: Hoy for Mac
Tagline: Walkie-talkie meets AirDrop meets Messages
Description: Hoy puts your people in your Mac's menu bar, on top of everything you do. Drop a file on a face. Hold to talk, and Hoy writes it down as you speak. Show your screen. Hand over a to-do. Every face is a channel, with one person or a group, and a link is all it takes to bring someone in. No sign-up, no middleman: your channels live in your own iCloud and there is no Hoy server. Free, with a pay-once Pro. Needs macOS 26. iPhone and iPad are coming soon.

Name: Offstage Cloud
Tagline: On-demand macOS sandboxes for AI agents
Description: Offstage gives AI agents and CI an on-demand macOS sandbox. Build iOS and Mac apps with Xcode, launch them in the Simulator, or hand an agent a real desktop. Pay per second with no 24-hour minimum. A 10-minute run costs about $0.18.

Name: Nameshot
Tagline: Your screenshots named automatically
Description: A tiny app that solves a big problem: naming your messy stash of "Screenshot 2025-12-15 at 06.59.24" nonsense entirely on device via Apple Intelligence.

Name: Omnigraph
Tagline: Open source graph database for your AI agents
Description: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

Name: ⌘+L
Tagline: Edit your website like Figma!
Description: Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

Name: Yogurt
Tagline: Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
Description: Yogurt takes AI meeting notes without joining your call as a bot. It records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams in the background, shows a live transcript, and writes a summary with next steps when the call ends. Ask questions across all your meetings, a folder or one call, even mid-meeting. Replay the full audio, share notes with Claude or ChatGPT via MCP, and recordings stop when the call does. Free, open source, no account. Everything stays on your computer. Works on Mac/Windows/Linux.

Name: Toki Matter
Tagline: The Al agent that advances your matters
Description: Personal agents can take work off your plate. Toki makes sure you never lose track of it. See everything Toki is handling, follow each goal’s progress in real time, step in when a decision needs you, then hand it back. Instead of managing the agent itself, you stay focused on the bigger picture while Toki keeps the work moving.

Name: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
Tagline: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market
Description: Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

Name: Adobe AI Assistant
Tagline: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
Topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Graphic Design
Description: Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

Name: Foxpit
Tagline: Run Claude Code, Codex & OpenCode as one AI team
Description: Foxpit turns your AI coding agents into one team in a 3D office. Fox, the lead, splits the task; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode build it in real terminals. Shared memory, auto-resume after usage limits, approvals in one place. Windows, macOS, Linux.

Name: Marqly 7.0
Tagline: Bookmarks you can query to find the things you saved
Description: Marqly 7.0 is a whole new Marqly. Your saves live in Collections: a moodboard Home, boards as stacks of their own covers, and Ask, a chat that answers from your own bookmarks with a source under every claim. Ask spots dead links and duplicates, files strays and tags new saves, and nothing changes until you approve. Free accounts get 5 Ask questions on us; Pro brings your library into ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Web, all major browsers, iPhone and Android.

Name: Insight7 Voice AI Agents
Tagline: AI voice agents that call your customers for you
Description: Insight7 Voice AI Agents call the customers your team never gets to. Describe the calls in one sentence, and the script, questions and calling schedule are drafted for you. Take the test call yourself before anyone else is called. Run it once, on a schedule, or let your systems trigger calls when a renewal comes due or a sign-up stalls. Every conversation comes back in one report: outcomes, patterns and the customers who need a person.

Name: Customer.io Fall Release
Tagline: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments
Description: Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.

Name: Cloudways Velocity
Tagline: Managed Node.js hosting. Always warm, never off.
Description: Deploy production-ready Node.js apps in minutes. Managed infrastructure, enterprise-grade security, and flat, predictable pricing, so there are no cold starts to worry about, and no billing surprises.

Name: three.dev
Tagline: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
Description: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.

Name: Infinite Drive
Tagline: A cloud drive you stream to give your laptop infinite space
Description: Fabric is a cloud drive that gives your laptop infinite space. Files take zero disk space and stream instantly, even 4K video into your editor. Find anything by describing it with AI search. For creatives, video editors and remote teams.
